newsitem.title: DENMARK: Denmark's Berendsen buys German firms.
newsitem.headline: Denmark's Berendsen buys German firms.

text.p: Danish service company Sophus Berendsen on Tuesday said it had bought three German linen service companies with a combined annual turnover of 250 million Danish crowns ($36.8 million).
In a statement, which did not disclose the purchase price, Berendsen said that it had bought Hospitex Testilservice GmbH, Neustaedter Textilservice GmbH and Moenning Textilpflege GmbH.
All three work mainly in the public sector, supplying linen and laundry services to hospitals and nursing homes.
Berendsen forecast that the acquisitions would boost its Textile Service division's turnover in Germany to about 500 million crowns.
Berendsen owns 35.8 percent of Britain's Rentokil Initial .
